editorial:
Imagine the Sun is about to swallow Earth, and instead of running away, humanity straps giant engines to the planet and drives it across space. That is the wild setup of this Chinese sci-fi blockbuster, and it is as big and bold as it sounds. You follow a young man and his family as they try to survive the freezing journey, deal with broken engines, and face a massive rescue mission. The movie throws you into a world of ice, fire, and giant machines, with a strong focus on family and teamwork. It feels like a mix of disaster movie and space adventure, with lots of heart underneath the action.

The visuals are huge and impressive, especially the giant Earth engines and the frozen cities. The action scenes are exciting and keep you on the edge of your seat, though the story can feel a bit messy at times. The acting is solid, and the emotional moments land well. If you love big sci-fi with lots of spectacle, this is for you.
endingExplained: In the final scenes, the team manages to restart the giant engines and save Earth from crashing into Jupiter. The young hero sacrifices himself to ignite the fuel and push the planet away, but he survives thanks to a rescue. Earth escapes the danger and continues its long journey to a new star system. The movie ends on a hopeful note, showing humanity united and determined to keep moving forward together.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves big sci-fi spectacles and disaster movies.
